A2AAttestationPayload.description:
The signed claim: which agent, for whom, bound to which request.

``agent`` reuses :class:`~warlog_spec.provider_abi.AiAgentRef` so the full
delegation tree (``sub_agents`` recursive, ``composition_kind``,
``tools_manifest_hash``) travels verbatim and projects 1:1 onto an
:class:`~warlog_spec.provider_abi.AutomationActor` on the audit chain.

agent.description: Verifiable identity of the calling agent (and its delegation chain).

agentId.description: Stable A2A identity of the agent (a did:web or URL). The subject the key_id is expected to belong to; the gateway binds the resolved public key to this id in its registry.
agentId.title: Agentid

audience.description: Target the attestation is minted for (gateway / tenant URI). The verifier rejects a mismatch so an attestation captured by one recipient cannot be presented to another.
audience.title: Audience

issuedAt.description: When the attestation was minted (aware UTC). Checked against the freshness window.
issuedAt.title: Issuedat

nonce.description: Single-use value for anti-replay. Signed here so the gateway can trust it after signature verification, then enforce uniqueness in its own (Redis) seen-cache within the freshness window.
nonce.title: Nonce

requestBinding.description: sha256 hex of (method || '|' || canonical_json_bytes(strip_meta(params))). Binds the attestation to THIS exact JSON-RPC call so it cannot be spliced onto a different request. Compute via compute_request_binding().
requestBinding.title: Requestbinding

A2AAttestationPayload.title: A2AAttestationPayload

A2ASignature.description:
Detached signature envelope for an :class:`A2AAttestationPayload`.

Mirrors :class:`~warlog_spec.provider_abi.AuditAttestation` but omits
``prev_row_hash`` : an attestation is a standalone claim, not a link in an
append-only chain. ``key_id`` follows RFC-0004 semantics (a URI / DID
resolving to the Ed25519 **public** key; the verifier fetches it out of
band — for warlog-mcp, from the tenant ``AgentKey`` registry).

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. Ed25519 only in v1 (RFC-0004 asymmetric path).
algorithm.title: Algorithm

signatureValue.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature over the domain-separated canonical payload bytes (64 bytes -> 128 hex).
signatureValue.title: Signaturevalue

keyId.description: Reference resolving to the Ed25519 public key (RFC-0004). Common patterns: 'did:web:acme.example#key-ed25519-1', 'https://keys.example.org/ed25519/v3.pem'. The gateway resolves it against its tenant agent-key registry.
keyId.title: Keyid

canonicalizationFormat.description: Canonical-bytes format identifier, decoupled from the payload's spec_version.
canonicalizationFormat.title: Canonicalizationformat

A2ASignature.title: A2ASignature

AgentCompositionKind.description:
Soft taxonomy of agent composition patterns.

Set on :class:`AiAgentRef.composition_kind` to tag the
architectural pattern this agent fits. Open via additive RFCs
when new patterns crystallize.
AgentCompositionKind.title: AgentCompositionKind

AiAgentRef.description:
Identity of an automated agent that initiated an action.

Required when :class:`AutomationActor` is the actor. The shape is
designed for EU AI Act traceability : an auditor can recompute
why an agent chose this action from the model identity, the
pinned system prompt, and the run-scoped reasoning artifact.

``system_prompt_hash`` is sha256 of the canonical system prompt
bytes — chains the agent's policy to the action. ``agent_run_id``
groups all actions emitted in one ReAct loop / one autonomous
decision-cycle. ``reasoning_artifact_ref`` optionally points at a
persisted CoT / tool-call trace (the operator decides where it
lives ; the ref is opaque).

RFC-0002 additive fields (all optional) extend attribution to
multi-agent compositions, tool-using agents, and RAG-grounded
agents :

- ``sub_agents`` — when an orchestrator delegated to peers /
  children, the chain of sub-agents that participated. Recursive.
- ``tools_manifest_hash`` — sha256 of the canonical-bytes
  serialization of the tool / MCP-server manifest available at
  decision time. Lets an auditor confirm no out-of-band tool was
  injected.
- ``retrieval_context_ref`` — opaque ref to the RAG context the
  agent had at decision time (vector-store query id, document
  set hash, …).
- ``composition_kind`` — soft taxonomy tag, defaults to ``SINGLE``
  / absent for backward compatibility.

systemPromptHash.description: sha256 of the canonical system prompt bytes (64 hex chars)
systemPromptHash.title: Systemprompthash

agentRunId.description: UUID grouping all actions for one agent decision-cycle
agentRunId.title: Agentrunid

reasoningArtifactRef.description: Opaque reference to the persisted reasoning artifact (CoT, tool-call trace). Operator-defined storage. Optional but strongly recommended for AI Act compliance.
reasoningArtifactRef.title: Reasoningartifactref

subAgents.description: Chain of sub-agents that participated in the decision. Recursive. Empty / absent means single-agent attribution.
subAgents.title: Subagents

toolsManifestHash.description: sha256 of the canonical-bytes serialization of the tool / MCP-server manifest available at decision time. Lets an auditor confirm the agent's tool surface was the expected one.
toolsManifestHash.title: Toolsmanifesthash

retrievalContextRef.description: Opaque reference to the retrieval context (RAG snapshot, vector-store query id, document set hash) the agent had at decision time.
retrievalContextRef.title: Retrievalcontextref

compositionKind.description: Soft taxonomy tag for the agent's composition pattern. None / absent means single-agent (legacy v1 attribution).

AiAgentRef.title: AiAgentRef

description: The full attestation envelope carried in transport ``_meta``.
title: A2AAttestation
